operating_entities.page_title: Beneva 2025 Annual Report - 'Org chart, As at December 31, 2025' (report pp. 12-13; PDF page 8)

entities.name: Beneva Mutual
entities.description: Mutual at the top of the chart (owner, with Fonds de solidarité FTQ, of Beneva Group Inc.). Financial statements: Beneva Mutual accounts for Beneva Group Inc. as a joint venture and Société financière Beneva inc. as an associate.

entities.name: Fonds de solidarité FTQ
entities.description: Shown in the chart (shaded, external investor) alongside Beneva Mutual; holds its interest through Société financière Beneva inc.

entities.name: Société de gestion Beneva inc.
entities.description: Holding company between Beneva Mutual and Beneva Group Inc. (no description on the chart).

entities.name: Société financière Beneva inc.
entities.parent: Fonds de solidarité FTQ / Beneva Mutual
entities.description: Holding company (associate of Beneva Mutual) whose main asset is its investment in Beneva Group Inc. (FS note 4).

entities.name: Beneva Group Inc.
entities.parent: Société de gestion Beneva inc. / Société financière Beneva inc.
entities.description: Group holding company; owner of the 'Beneva' trademarks ('The Beneva name and logo are registered trademarks of Beneva Group Inc. used under licence', site footer).

entities.name: Beneva Inc.
entities.description: The life and health insurer and parent of the operating subsidiaries ('Savings products are issued by Beneva Inc.'; site copyright 'Beneva Inc.'); A.M. Best A (Excellent), stable.

entities.name: Beneva Real Estate Management Inc.
entities.description: Real estate management subsidiary (no description on the chart).

entities.name: Beneva Insurance Company
entities.description: P&C insurer (formerly La Capitale General Insurance Inc., renamed 2023-01-01); A.M. Best A (Excellent), stable.

entities.name: Beneva Investment Services Inc.
entities.description: Fund dealer subsidiary (no description on the chart).

entities.name: L'Unique General Insurance Inc.
entities.description: P&C insurer (broker channel, Quebec); A.M. Best A (Excellent), stable.

entities.name: Unica Insurance Inc.
entities.description: Ontario-based P&C subsidiary; A.M. Best A (Excellent), stable.

entities.name: Gore Insurance Company*
entities.description: '* As at January 1, 2026' - Gore Mutual merged into Beneva effective 2026-01-01 ('Beneva and Gore Mutual combine operations', who-we-are timeline).

ga_manager_statement.text: Beneva 'decreased the carbon intensity of its internally managed portfolio by 39% compared to 2021' (2025 results release, 2026-04-23) - i.e. the general fund is managed in-house; the Institutional Investment Services page states that for third-party institutional clients 'We only work with external managers'.

operating_entities.note: No HTML 'our companies' page exists on beneva.ca (checked /en/who-we-are, /en/legal, /en/joining-forces, /en/financial-information, /en/team; /en/about-us, /en/legal-notice and /en/about-us/our-companies return 404). The org chart in the 2025 Annual Report hosted on beneva.ca is the insurer's own entity disclosure; the financial-information page separately lists the four A.M. Best-rated entities (Beneva Inc., Beneva Insurance Company, L'Unique General Insurance Inc., Unica Insurance Inc.). The chart gives names only; descriptions are drawn from other beneva.ca pages and the FS notes as indicated.

ceo.name: Jean-François Chalifoux
ceo.title: President and CEO, Beneva
ceo.reports_to: Boards of Beneva Inc. / Beneva Mutual (Chair Jean St-Gelais per round 1)
ceo.prior: CEO, SSQ Insurance (2015-2020); earlier executive positions at major Canadian P&C and L&H insurers; FCIA, FCAS; BSc actuarial science Université Laval
ceo.note: President and CEO 'since its creation in 2020' (La Capitale/SSQ merger 2020-07). industry_since null: bio gives no start year. Mutual: no proxy circular, pay not disclosed. CEO of the Year, Insurance Business Canada Awards 2025.

cio.title: Not publicly identified (no Chief Investment Officer or VP Investments on the management team or in the 2025 Annual Report)
cio.note: The 11-person management team (beneva.ca, information as at 2026-04-01) and the AR's 'expanded leadership team' (Michel Fournier VP Risk Management, Josée Grondines VP Internal Audit, Frédéric Mantha VP AI and Data) contain no investment executive; the internally managed general fund (C$18.9bn total investments at 2025-12-31) sits under EVP Finance Mélissa Gilbert by inference (her La Capitale title covered 'Finance, Corporate Actuarial and Risk Management'). Board Investment Committee reviews the portfolio quarterly (AR note 7).

other_leaders.name: Mélissa Gilbert
other_leaders.title: Executive Vice-President and Leader, Finance (also interim Leader, Business Performance and Information Technology)
other_leaders.reports_to: Jean-François Chalifoux, President and CEO (inferred: management team)
other_leaders.prior: EVP Finance, Corporate Actuarial and Risk Management, La Capitale (Dec 2018 to the 2020 merger); previously CFO and strategic roles in service companies; FCPA, FCA, ASC
other_leaders.tenure_source: company bio (beneva.ca) for 2018-12; seat 2020 inferred from merger date (bio says she played a key role in bringing La Capitale and SSQ together)
other_leaders.note: seat_since 2020 is inferred from the merger (not a stated appointment date). Likely senior executive over the in-house investment function (inferred). Pay not disclosed.

other_leaders.name: Michel Fournier
other_leaders.title: Vice-President, Risk Management (functionally related to the Risk, Ethics and IT Management Committee of the Board)
other_leaders.reports_to: Functionally to the Board's Risk, Ethics and IT Management Committee (stated in AR); administrative line not stated
other_leaders.note: Listed among 'expanded leadership team members' (AR p.10-11, information as of 2026-04-01). No bio or tenure found; not on the beneva.ca team page.
